name: h2_greedy_plus_3_validation
temperature_scope: sampled route and customer logits after the feasibility mask; greedy argmax is not scaled
returned_route: shortest feasible among 1 greedy and 3 samples; ties keep the earlier candidate, greedy first
cost: sum of the four decode runtimes and frvcpy executions
decision_rule: A temperature is promising if at least 4 of 5 seeds have a negative RL-minus-BC anchored duration and the paired Student-t 95% interval lies entirely below zero. Both temperatures are reported. This validation set was already used to choose the earlier reporting protocol.
